w6g-again.zh: 这家我们来过啦，去下一家吧！
w6g-again.en: We’ve been here already — on to the next house!

w6g-nobody.zh: 没人在家……门上贴着「出去讨糖啦」！
w6g-nobody.en: Nobody’s home… the note says “Out trick-or-treating!”

w6g-treat-hour.zh: 门廊的灯都亮起来了，正是讨糖的好时候！
w6g-treat-hour.en: The porch lights are on — perfect time for trick-or-treating!

w6g-big-night.zh: 今晚是万圣节！每家都开门，糖果还加倍！
w6g-big-night.en: It’s Halloween night! Every door’s open, and the treats are doubled!

w6g-not-too-much.zh: 糖果留着慢慢吃，一次别吃太多哦！
w6g-not-too-much.en: Let’s save some candy — not too much at once!

w6g-all-doors.zh: 哇，我们敲遍了所有的门！
w6g-all-doors.en: Wow — we’ve knocked on every single door!

w6g-season-over.zh: 万圣节过去啦，明年再来讨糖吧！
w6g-season-over.en: Halloween’s over — let’s come trick-or-treating again next year!

w6g-street-belvedere.zh: 贝尔维德街是城里最有名的万圣节讨糖街之一，往年还会封街！
w6g-street-belvedere.en: Belvedere Street is one of the city’s best-known Halloween streets — it usually closes to cars, too!

w6g-street-chenery.zh: 格伦公园的 Chenery 街，往年万圣节傍晚会封街讨糖。
w6g-street-chenery.en: In Glen Park, Chenery Street usually closes to cars on Halloween evening for trick-or-treaters.

w6g-street-fair-oaks.zh: Fair Oaks 街是诺伊谷的万圣节老地方，往年会封街！
w6g-street-fair-oaks.en: Fair Oaks Street is Noe Valley’s Halloween classic — it usually closes to cars!

w6g-street-jordan.zh: 乔丹公园这边，往年万圣节 Jordan 大道会封街讨糖。
w6g-street-jordan.en: Here in Jordan Park, Jordan Avenue usually closes to cars for Halloween.

w6g-street-sea-cliff.zh: 海崖区的大房子万圣节都装饰得好隆重，每年有好几百人来讨糖！
w6g-street-sea-cliff.en: Sea Cliff’s big houses go all out for Halloween — hundreds of trick-or-treaters come every year!

w6g-street-hearst.zh: 阳光谷的 Hearst 大道，往年万圣节傍晚也会封街讨糖。
w6g-street-hearst.en: In Sunnyside, Hearst Avenue usually closes to cars on Halloween evening too.

w6g-costume-witch.en: Do I look like a little witch?

w6g-costume-pumpkin.zh: 嘿嘿，今天我是一颗南瓜！
w6g-costume-pumpkin.en: Hee hee — today I’m a pumpkin!

w6g-costume-ghost.en: Whoa! A little ghost — you made me jump!

w6g-costume-cat.en: Meow~ I love your cat ears!

w6g-costume-first.zh: 穿上服装，我们就能去讨糖啦！
w6g-costume-first.en: Now we’re in costume, we can go trick-or-treating!

w6g-goal-done.zh: 敲开了五户人家的门，糖果袋满满的！
w6g-goal-done.en: Five doors knocked — our candy bag is full!

w6-h-season-hello.zh: 十月啦！家家门口都摆上了南瓜灯～
w6-h-season-hello.en: It’s October! There are pumpkins on every doorstep.

w6-h-night-glow.zh: 天黑了，门口的南瓜灯都亮起来啦，好温暖。
w6-h-night-glow.en: It’s dark now — all the jack-o’-lanterns are glowing. So cosy.

w6-h-bats.zh: 看天上！小蝙蝠在绕圈圈～别怕，它们只爱吃虫子。
w6-h-bats.en: Look up! Little bats circling. Don’t worry — they only eat bugs.

w6-h-ghosts.zh: 那边有小幽灵和小南瓜！是邻居家的小朋友扮的吧～
w6-h-ghosts.en: A little ghost and a little pumpkin! The neighbours’ kids dressed up.

w6-h-big-night.zh: 今晚是万圣节大夜晚！整条街都亮着南瓜灯。
w6-h-big-night.en: Tonight’s the big Halloween night! The whole street is glowing.

w6-h-dusk.zh: 南瓜色的黄昏，有一点点神秘，又很温柔～
w6-h-dusk.en: A pumpkin-coloured dusk — a little spooky, and very cosy.

w6-h-hunt-first.zh: 找到一个藏起来的南瓜灯！全城还藏着好多个呢～
w6-h-hunt-first.en: A hidden jack-o’-lantern! There are lots more hiding around the city.

w6-h-hunt-sniff.zh: 咦，附近好像有南瓜灯的光……
w6-h-hunt-sniff.en: Hm — I can see a pumpkin glow somewhere near…

w6-h-hunt-night.zh: 藏起来的南瓜灯晚上会发光，天黑了更好找哦。
w6-h-hunt-night.en: The hidden lanterns glow at night — they’re easier to spot after dark.

w6-h-hunt-10.zh: 十个南瓜灯啦！你是寻宝高手！
w6-h-hunt-10.en: Ten jack-o’-lanterns! You’re a real treasure hunter!

w6-h-hunt-20.zh: 二十个了！已经找到一半啦～
w6-h-hunt-20.en: Twenty! That’s half of them found.

w6-h-hunt-all.zh: 四十个全找齐啦！今年的南瓜王就是你！
w6-h-hunt-all.en: All forty! You’re this year’s Pumpkin King!

w6-h-muertos-hello.zh: 今天是亡灵节！教会区挂满了彩色剪纸旗，还有万寿菊。
w6-h-muertos-hello.en: It’s Día de los Muertos! The Mission is full of papel picado and marigolds.

w6-h-muertos-altar.zh: 这是纪念亲人的祭坛，有照片、蜡烛和万寿菊。我们轻轻地看。
w6-h-muertos-altar.en: An altar for loved ones — photos, candles, marigolds. Let’s look quietly.

w6-h-muertos-marigold.zh: 传说万寿菊的橙色和香味，能给思念的人照亮回家的路。
w6-h-muertos-marigold.en: They say the marigolds’ colour and scent light the way home for those we miss.

w6-h-muertos-procession.zh: 每年 11 月 2 日晚上，大家从 22 街和布莱恩特街口出发游行。
w6-h-muertos-procession.en: Every 2 November, in the evening, a procession sets off from 22nd and Bryant.

w6-h-muertos-all.zh: 每个祭坛都看过啦。谢谢你陪我一起记住大家。
w6-h-muertos-all.en: We’ve seen every altar. Thank you for remembering with me.
